reviewer_attacks.title: Primary shift is not a clean real-concept-drift experiment
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Keep primary claim fixed-scenario/source-regime bounded; Stage-10+ requires direct attack-pattern/conditional-label-change, gradual/unseen where defensible, and second dataset.

reviewer_attacks.title: Controlled boundary is not metaphysical drift ground truth
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Use designated controlled boundary/reference; pre-reference detector event; no true-natural-drift-point claim.

reviewer_attacks.title: Pre-reference detector events consumed D-drift symbolic budget
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Stage-9 detector/latency robustness completed; report clocks/budget centrally; Stage-10+ includes cleaner post-change opportunity structure.

reviewer_attacks.title: E1 does not prove evolved symbolic knowledge beats neural-only adaptation
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Mechanism decomposition completed as secondary/exploratory; retain withdrawal-dominant interpretation; Stage-10+ prospectively tests lifecycle-authority semantics.

reviewer_attacks.title: Explanation endpoint deteriorates
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Report negative MCSC without euphemism; no explanation-recovery primary success claim.

reviewer_attacks.title: MCSC construct validity is limited
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Define MCSC narrowly as class-balanced correct symbolic coverage; triangulate explanation constructs; no analyst-usefulness claim without separate evaluation.

reviewer_attacks.title: Candidate selection/common-validation winner's curse
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Do not treat accepted rules as independently hypothesis-tested discoveries; Stage-10+ requires independent/nested candidate confirmation and gate sensitivity.

reviewer_attacks.title: CICIDS2017 quality/artifact dependence
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Dataset-bounded claims; corrected-CICIDS sensitivity where useful plus truly independent second dataset.

reviewer_attacks.title: Shortcut learning/source-regime cues
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Retain feature/duplicate diagnostics; cross-dataset/scenario replication is decisive.

reviewer_attacks.title: Five seeds are not five environments
reviewer_attacks.disposition: No environmental-population interpretation; no pseudo-replication; replicate scenarios/datasets instead.

reviewer_attacks.title: Sign-test/Holm power is intrinsically coarse
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Emphasize magnitude/raw pairs/uncertainty; no p-value headline; no post-hoc test switching.

reviewer_attacks.title: Replay assumptions and poisoning
reviewer_attacks.disposition: No-replay ablation completed; trusted-label/replay-integrity assumption disclosed; poisoning/noise stress required only for operational-robustness claim.

reviewer_attacks.title: Complete delayed labels are optimistic
reviewer_attacks.disposition: L=0 and L=10000 completed; fixed-row delay disclosed; partial/noisy/missing labels prospectively tested if operational claims are made.

reviewer_attacks.title: Supervised hard-error detector is only one monitor class
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Page-Hinkley hard-error and ADWIN-Brier completed; label-free monitor may be added only as separately frozen diagnostic/replication.

reviewer_attacks.title: Periodic comparator cadence
reviewer_attacks.disposition: State cadence is one matched comparator; no trigger-superiority claim; random/alternative clocks only if superiority is claimed.

reviewer_attacks.title: Neural architecture specificity
reviewer_attacks.disposition: MLP is controlled backbone, not novelty; second materially different backbone required for architecture-invariant claim.

reviewer_attacks.title: Neuro-symbolic terminology can be challenged
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Define teacher-derived, true-label-validated symbolic lifecycle operationally; no expert-knowledge/theorem-reasoning claim.

reviewer_attacks.title: Real-time/deployment claims unsupported
reviewer_attacks.disposition: No throughput/backlog/real-time production claim from logical-row-time evidence.

reviewer_attacks.title: Adversarial robustness untested
reviewer_attacks.disposition: No adversarial-robustness claim; separately frozen adversarial evaluation only if operational security robustness is claimed.

reviewer_attacks.title: Novelty is crowded and moving
reviewer_attacks.disposition: Retain narrow gap; no first-ever claim; adversarial literature refresh before major replication milestones and submission.

class_b_closure_rule: Every Class B attack must have either completed frozen robustness/mechanism evidence or a prospectively frozen Stage-10+ sensitivity obligation; primary Stage-8/9 result is never replaced.
class_c_closure_rule: Every Class C attack must carry an explicit claim boundary and/or replication obligation.
